title: Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics for Insights into Vibrational Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy
content: A fundamental challenge in electron microscopy is bridging the gap between high-accuracy theoretical calculations and experimental observations. While density functional theory (DFT) provides precise atomistic calculations, it cannot handle the large-scale systems typically studied in experiments. Machine-learned potentials, trained on DFT data, offer a promising solution by delivering DFT-level accuracy while enabling calculations at significantly expanded spatiotemporal scales. In this work, we combine machine learning molecular dynamics (MLMD) with multislice simulations [1,2] to compute phonon spectra in complex materials at experimentally relevant scales. We then directly compare these results with monochromated electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS) measurements.
